reviews.text: I am very grateful to them because they have already treated my dog ​​out of turn twice in an emergency, while other hospitals have made me wait hours in similar situations. Basically, they are always very kind and their professional skills are excellent.

Doctor Hajnalka Gizella and assistant Tekla Solcan were very kind, empathetic with my dog, and they tried to make the nail trimming as quick and gentle as possible. They also gave me a delicious, creamy treat, which made this little procedure much more bearable. :) We would be happy to come back here again, but only if necessary. :) thank you very much for your kindness and patience! :)

I only bring my dogs here.
I noticed that they do it as a profession.
Thank you for the quick help! Professional doctor and helper 😊
My puppy was always very happy when we came here and we always left happy and healthy when we left😊you can really trust us🫶🏻 …
Fantastic, kind and patient doctors with a lot of experience. Always available ❤️
Very beautiful and it's a shame there's no entrance.

I recommend it wholeheartedly! The veterinarians are extremely kind, professionally prepared, and the assistants are always helpful and attentive. It is noticeable that the welfare of the animals is their number one priority. They always provide the best possible care. I am very grateful for their care and conscientious work. Thank you for everything!

It's not enough that every time you enter, the ladies at the counter are always on their feet, laughing somewhere. They didn't give my dogs medicine today! Plus, I couldn't even file a complaint because they didn't give me a customer book! I'll notify the authorities as soon as possible! Everyone should avoid this filthy place!
They were perfect in every way. I recommend them to everyone!
They helped my cat Laura a lot in her recovery!

Dear Owners:) I would like to share with you my recent experiences, we had our little male cat neutered on Wednesday:) today is the first day of the surgery, we expected the worst but we experienced nothing but nothing, Zulu is doing well, he is healing easily, the wound is perfect, minimal incision, no stitches, the approach to us is simply five stars, we get kind, satisfactory answers to all our questions, they always answer the phone, I have rarely experienced such kind treatment! Thank you very much!! We are grateful for all the kind words, and for the fact that our little pet only had minimal pain, it is worth every penny! I wholeheartedly recommend it to everyone who is thinking about neutering and is afraid (there can be few patients more worried than us) five stars everything

Hello owners! We have been coming here with our beloved dog since he was little, and the moment of neutering has come, which we were afraid of, because you can read a lot in all kinds of groups about what the experiences are. Obviously, it is bad for a person to see their dog in a sedated state, no matter what kind of surgery it is. There was no question that we would have the surgery performed here with a modern procedure and a welcome that is right for both the dog and the owner. I like when they approach things humanely, and we were there with the dog until he fell asleep, and we were also there immediately after the surgery when he woke up. After the surgery, we waited until he regained consciousness and only then did we set off. We discussed everything, they were helpful and kind in everything. We would like to thank the doctor and her assistant, as well as the doctor who performs the daily treatments on our dog.
I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone who believes that dogs deserve humane treatment!
They always meet the challenges with great attention, kindness and expertise. Dr. Sótonyi is an excellent surgeon.

We had our dogs Honey and Candy neutered here with minimally invasive surgery. Friendly staff. Dr. Kata Sótonyi is very prepared and thorough. Everything went well with the surgery. I can only recommend her. 😊😊 …

On my first visit we've met Adam and he was the kind of vet that you know immediately that your pet is in the right hands. He is professional very thorough and trustworthy.
So I've decided to have my dog neutered here as well, the surgery was done by Dr. Sótonyi Kata and I'm in awe of the professional treatment my boy got. Just to put it in perspective, I've had a dozen pets over the years and met a lot of vets and maybe because my father was a surgeon I have too high expectations, but I've always been a bit disappointed in the vetenary surgery parctices until now, but Kata did such an amazing job she managed to impress even me. I'm a real worrywart when it comes to my pets, but the whole team was so professional it helped so much to put my mind at ease while they were working on my dog.
Thank you all very much, keep up the good work!
By far the best veterinary practice out there, could not recommend them any more.
They helped us in our difficult situation. (Laura cat)

The environment is always very clean, friendly, and the entire team is incredibly kind and professional. Every time I feel that my dog ​​is in the best possible hands.

I would like to especially highlight Dr. Ádám Walker, who is always patient, helpful, and helped us a lot. And thanks to Dr. Kata Sótonyi for the neutering, everything was done very precisely and carefully.

What is a special plus for me is that my dog ​​is not afraid here at all, although elsewhere he used to tremble from the beginning. He is calm here, and it is clear that he has had good experiences.

They always answer any questions I have, it is really clear that the animals come first. After every visit, we go home calmly and with a good feeling. I can only recommend it to everyone! 🐶
We came with my dog ​​for an ear cleaning. He was treated with proper attention, care, and patience.

I have been going to the Viza-Vet veterinary clinic with my puppies Louie and Luna for almost two years now. Every time I visit, I am amazed by how much attention, patience and sincere love they show to their little patients. From the very first moment, you can feel that they really work here with all their heart and soul, and that they treat the animals not only as “patients”, but also as family members.

As an owner, the most reassuring feeling is that if I have any questions or uncertainties, they always help me willingly, understandably and with great empathy, and they truly keep Louie and Luna’s interests in mind in every decision. They are incredibly precise, conscientious and kind, which gives me a huge sense of security.

I wholeheartedly recommend the Viza-Vet team to anyone looking for a veterinary clinic where professional expertise is accompanied by real care and attention. ❤️🐾

I can only say the best about this veterinary clinic 🐾😍
Incredibly professional team, they work with great expertise, but what is most important to me: they are infinitely patient and incredibly helpful. They answer every question calmly and clearly, and I always feel that the interests of the little patients really come first.
As an owner, it is very reassuring to know that my puppies are in such loving, attentive hands. I recommend them to everyone from the bottom of my heart!🥹🐾
Very nice, accurate :)

The doctor examined our dog with incredible kindness, humanity and patience, even without an appointment, for her own reasons. The doctor asked us thoroughly about it, and after the examination, she made a detailed diagnosis and we discussed several possible treatment options. We would like to thank all the staff for everything. We wholeheartedly recommend the clinic to anyone.
They are very kind, professionally prepared, and last but not least, they love animals very much!
Very friendly, super professional team, thank you very much for your work!
I got an appointment very quickly, they are kind, conscientious and my cat received great care. I highly recommend them.

We came to the clinic through a recommendation, for which we can only be grateful. The clinic is nice and clean, both the doctors and the assistants are super nice and considerate. The best thing was that they said that if there is anything, I should feel free to call them, because there is no stupid question and I should ask calmly (we go to them with our 4-month-old puppy). :)

Doctor Kata was very kind, empathetic, skilled and provided my puppy with quick, relatively painless care. Fortunately, we only came for a nail trim. :) She even took the time to pet, groom, and get to know him before the examination. We were very happy with this pleasant experience. We would be happy to return next time, but only if necessary. :)

We arrived for our first check-up with a scared and inexperienced, newly adopted shelter cat. We received extremely thorough and careful care. The cat was treated with incredible patience and kindness throughout, both the doctor and the assistant. We are not looking for another vet :)

I have never given a negative review of a veterinary clinic. We have been here a few times, I have always paid the most here, but this is irrelevant. Our dog has had rashes like this several times, so I knew what kind of cream was needed for it, I wanted to avoid paying again for them to just look at it and prescribe the cream. Of course, only money is important, if they don't see it and you don't pay the fee for looking at it, they won't give you the CREAM that requires a prescription! So we are not talking about a serious medicine.

In response to their answer: I had the dog in my hands, so if it wasn't about money, the doctor would have just said to look at its belly, but he said twice that he wouldn't do it without an examination (i.e. not without paying the examination fee), all this while saying that although he is not our doctor, we have been here several times. Obviously, I wouldn't even think of asking for something I'm not 100% sure about, because I consider myself a responsible owner, and I'd rather take my dog ​​for an unnecessary test than trivialize it. If a given thing happens to my dog ​​several times, they prescribe it several times, and we're really talking about an ointment, then I think the test fee does matter if they don't want to prescribe it.
Glad I found this place for my cat, super clean, all doctors speaks in English and are very patient and professional , I can only recommend! 💎 …

We have been going to them for 2 years now with Barack, who is always happy to enter the office, which is a big deal because he was terrified at the previous place. Doctors Kata and Petra are also very kind and take great care of our dog, they have treated him for diseases that were misdiagnosed elsewhere. I can only say so many positive things about them, thank you for everything! :)
Conscientious, thorough, helpful Team! Thank you for the countless help! 🙏🏻🐶❤️ …

A lovely little clinic, with extremely kind, thorough doctors and nurses. I took an old Beagle for surgery with several problems, and they solved it professionally. Stress-free, thorough service. Good place for pets.
They are very kind and reliable! :)
Very professional, nice team! I can only recommend it! 🥰 …
Malna wouldn't go anywhere else ❤️
Dear Morti Mer! There is no owner or patient with this name in our database. What kind of pet did you visit us with, and why were you not satisfied?
Excuse me, but what's the problem? Why did you give such a rating? Have you been to the clinic?
We go to them with both of our cats! They are always kind and helpful, both on the phone and in person🥰🐈🐈 …

My partner was here with our dog the first time, and I took them the last time, both times they did a conscientious job, all of them! 😊 it's not easy with our dog, but they solved the situation, we can only recommend them! 🐶 …

I took my 3 year old dog because he was sick and not well, during the examination they didn't listen to his breathing or heart. We were given some medicine which he took, but despite that, his condition didn't improve, but got worse, which I reported on the phone to them, and I got the answer that I don't need to come in. Then the next day my dog ​​suddenly collapsed on the street and died.
I think they made a mistake, they weren't thorough enough, they didn't examine him properly, and when I reported that he was getting worse, they didn't welcome us! I hope this doesn't happen to anyone else.

In response to an answer
I see you write all sorts of things that never happened or you just write them upside down to avoid responsibility.
If you've been listened to many times, why didn't you notice that there was something wrong with his heart? (because it was not listened to)
We went there not only with a diarrhea problem, but also with several other symptoms that were listed by the Doctor, but the Doctor attributed these symptoms to the fact that he was hot and they only dealt with the diarrhea problem.
How could he have run? If he could barely walk and he wasn't even tied up!
So when we were always at your place, they mixed up the good and the bad and thought of me as a bad owner.
Very kind, friendly doctor takes care of our pets😍 …
I can only recommend it!
Very kind and correct service. High quality ☺️

Everyone is very nice, professional team.
It was the best decision we made choosing them.
Fantastic team! In addition to their dedication and professionalism, they are kind, flexible and above all, they truly love animals. I am very happy that my cat is in their caring hands.
